_meta.name: Meeting Intelligence & Follow-up
_meta.description: Converts professional conversations into structured memory, follow-up actions, and meeting preparation.

nodes.name: Conversation Capture
nodes.subtitle: Audio & Notes Ingest
nodes.description: Captures raw conversation audio, notes, or uploaded transcripts as the primary workflow entrypoint.

nodes.name: Process Conversation
nodes.subtitle: Transcription & Entity Extraction
nodes.description: Processes raw conversation dialogue, identifies speakers, and extracts key decisions, entities, and context.

nodes.name: Central Memory
nodes.subtitle: Structured Memory Store
nodes.description: Persists structured dialogue memory, attendee context, and historical commitments into central database index.

nodes.name: Action Generator
nodes.subtitle: Task & Decision Synthesis
nodes.description: Synthesizes actionable follow-up tasks, assignees, deadlines, and draft communications from meeting decisions.

nodes.name: Follow-up & Meeting Prep
nodes.subtitle: Dispatch & Briefing Sync
nodes.description: Dispatches follow-up emails, schedules milestone calendar invites, and prepares upcoming meeting briefing packets.
